draft_rulings.rule: Thirteen roots are respelled: lenra -> zarku; vanru -> dokra; voho -> kezdo; vabale -> tobra; teyo -> dento; mege -> yumli; kupa -> ruko; jemla -> zimzi; pesbi -> bondo; menha -> gamdo; vugo -> vizu; salye -> bapi; senba -> linle. 2.1:G58 applies in full: a respelled root keeps every meaning and empty slot; all forms, derivations, compounds and image compounds respell with it; compound verbs follow the new first letter; 2.2 spellings retired; older texts, including the album, are read under the spellings they were written in.

bumbo (bear), murmu (cow; cattle) and kerku (frog) are new roots. They replace larbopagoregna, maremirulazu and the listed derivation mirunululirayo, which are retired; kerku takes the verb kerkuka, to croak. mirunululira (river-song) stays.
larbopagobudi -> farvibudi (farvi + budi), 'wild dog', read like farvilazu (wild animal); lunolarbopagobudi -> lunofarvibudi. Supersedes the wolf half of 2.1:G59; its taha -> kezupago half stands.

root_respellings.gloss: enemy; active adversary, not merely unloved; foe
insect; six-legged arthropod in ordinary usage

derivation_to_root.new_line: kerku {formerly mirunululirayo}: (n) frog | kerkuka (v) to croak
derivation_to_root.note: remove from lexicalised_derivations; mirunululirayo stays buildable by the default -yo reading ('one devoted to river-song'). kerkuka (v) to croak is a new meaningful form.

headword_migration.new_dictionary_line: bondo {formerly pesbi}: (n) weight | bondona (nn) lightness | bondoba (v) to weigh | bondonasan (na) light (in weight) | bondosan (a) heavy
ruko {formerly kupa, barni}: (n) blood | rukona (nn) bloodlessness | rukora (v) to bleed | rukonasan (na) bloodless | rukosan (a) bloody; blood-red
gamdo {formerly menha}: (n) jaw | gamdoga (v) to clench the jaw | gamdosan (a) tight-jawed
dento {formerly teyo}: (n) tooth | dentoda (v) to bite | dentosan (a) toothed
zimzi {formerly jemla}: (n) insect; six-legged arthropod in ordinary usage | zimzisan (a) insect-related; entomological

kezdo {formerly voho}: (n) revenge; retaliation; vengeance | kezdoasa (an) revenge pursued beyond death | kezdona (nn) reconciliation after injury | kezdoka (v) to avenge; to retaliate | kezdonasan (na) reconciled instead of vengeful | kezdosan (a) vengeful; retaliatory | kezdoasasan (aa) vengeance claimed as destiny
bapi {formerly salye}: (n) surprise | bapina (nn) the expected; nothing surprising | bapiba (v) to surprise | bapinasan (na) unsurprising | bapisan (a) surprising
tobra {formerly vabale}: (n) wall | tobrata (v) to wall off | tobrasan (a) walled
yumli {formerly mege}: (n) sweetness | yumlina (nn) bitterness | yumliya (v) to sweeten | yumlinasan (na) bitter | yumlisan (a) sweet; pleasant

linle {formerly senba}: (n) cleanliness | linleasa (an) purity of soul; holiness | linlena (nn) dirtiness | linlela (v) to cleanse | linlenasan (na) dirty | linlesan (a) clean | linleasasan (aa) pure; sanctified
vizu {formerly vugo, velbi}: (n) speed | vizuna (nn) slowness | vizuva (v) to accelerate | vizunasan (na) slow | vizusan (a) swift; quick
zarku {formerly lenra}: (n) enemy; active adversary, not merely unloved; foe | zarkuna (nn) ally | zarkuza (v) to oppose as an enemy | zarkusan (a) hostile

dokra {formerly vanru}: (n) war | dokraasa (an) the war in heaven; the last battle | dokrana (nn) peacetime; the absence of war | dokrada (v) to wage war | dokranasan (na) at peace; unwarlike | dokrasan (a) warlike
farvibudi [farvi+budi] {formerly larbopagobudi, volda}: (n) wolf | farvibudifa (v) to hunt in a pack | farvibudisan (a) wolfish
bumbo {formerly larbopagoregna}: (n) bear
murmu {formerly maremirulazu}: (n) cow; cattle
zimzitino [zimzi+tino] {formerly jemlatino}: (n) insect kind
zimziyano [zimzi+yano] {formerly jemlayano}: (n) insect swarm
vizulavi [vizu+lavi] {formerly vugolavi, velbilavi}: (n) excitement | vizulavina (nn) unhurried calm; the absence of excitement | vizulaviva (v) to excite | vizulavisan (a) excited
rukorivla [ruko+rivla] {formerly kuparivla, barnirivla}: (n) circulation; the flow of blood
yumlipusa [yumli+pusa] {formerly megepusa}: (n) sugar
talizimzi [tali+zimzi] {formerly talijemla}: (n) ant
tibidento [tibi+dento] {formerly tibiteyo}: (n) needle | tibidentota (v) to sew
rukovolme [ruko+volme] {formerly kupavolme, barnivolme}: (n) vampire
lunofarvibudi [luno+farvibudi] {formerly lunolarbopagobudi, lunovolda}: (n) werewolf
dokrayano [dokra+yano] {formerly vanruyano}: (n) army; host (an army)
folniyumli [folni+yumli] {formerly folnimege}: (n) floral nectar | folniyumlina (nn) nectarless flower | folniyumlifa (v) to gather nectar | folniyumlisan (a) nectar-sweet
rukorale [ruko+rale] {formerly kuparale, barnirale}: (n) pulse | rukoralera (v) to pulse; to throb
dentonuravu [dento+nuravu] {formerly teyonuravu}: (n) toothache
linlebiti [linle+biti] {formerly senbabiti}: (n) broom | linlebitila (v) to sweep
gamdosabaye [gamdo+sabaye] {formerly menhasabaye}: (n) beard
faruzimzi [faru+zimzi] {formerly farujemla}: (n) firefly
zarkulavi [zarku+lavi] {poetic, formerly lenralavi}: (n) joy at an enemy’s misfortune
dokralirbu [dokra+lirbu] {formerly vanrulirbu}: (n) commander; officer
demrovizu [demro+vizu] {formerly demrovugo, demrovelbi}: (n) speed of movement
bondovordu [bondo+vordu] {formerly pesbivordu}: (n) gravity
jomruvizu [jomru+vizu] {formerly jomruvugo, jomruvelbi}: (n) travel speed
bapihavli [bapi+havli] {formerly salyehavli}: (n) gasp | bapihavliba (v) to gasp | bapihavlisan (a) gasping
bapisemra [bapi+semra] {formerly salyesemra}: (n) embarrassment | bapisemraba (v) to embarrass | bapisemrasan (a) embarrassed
dokradomlu [dokra+domlu] {formerly vanrudomlu}: (n) fortress; castle
vizurabi [vizu+rabi] {formerly vugorabi, velbirabi}: (n) dash; sprint; rush | vizurabiva (v) to dash; to rush | vizurabisan (a) rushing
vizuvalmi [vizu+valmi] {formerly vugovalmi, velbivalmi}: (n) hurry; haste | vizuvalmiva (v) to hurry | vizuvalmisan (a) hurried; hasty
kronotobra [krono+tobra] {formerly kronovabale}: (n) deadline | kronotobraka (v) to set a deadline
talibondo [tali+bondo] {formerly talipesbi}: (n) workload
dokravalmi [dokra+valmi] {formerly vanruvalmi}: (n) march | dokravalmida (v) to march
bojidento [boji+dento] {formerly bojiteyo, yelfateyo}: (n) icicle; hanging spear of ice | bojidentoba (v) to form icicles | bojidentosan (a) icicle-hung
vizuvaye [vizu+vaye] {formerly vugovaye, velbivaye}: (n) gust; brief strong wind | vizuvayeva (v) to gust suddenly | vizuvayesan (a) gusty; buffeted
